---
title: "Privacy"
---

Sjónabókarstafróf is a static website on GitHub Pages. It has no accounts, and text you type in
*Test the fonts* stays in your browser.

When you first visit, a cookie notice lets you choose which outside services the site may use. It
works like the one on hi.is and uses the same open-source consent manager,
[Klaro!](https://github.com/KIProtect/klaro). There are two groups:

- **Analytics** (off until you allow it): [Google Analytics](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites),
  loaded through Google Tag Manager, counts visits and shows which pages are read. Until you allow
  it, nothing is sent to Google Analytics and no `_ga` cookies are set. If you allow it, it records
  the pages you open, your browser type and an approximate location (country or city). Google
  Analytics 4 does not store IP addresses, and advertising features are switched off.
- **Appearance** (required): the Jost typeface is loaded from Google Fonts.

Your choice is kept in your own browser and also applies to the other HiDef Textiles sites on
hideftextiles.github.io. You can change it any time with [Cookie settings](#analytics-settings) in
the footer.

Questions about the data go to HiDef Textiles, Háskóli Íslands.
